description.fun: Zekrom flies through Unova hidden inside thunderclouds, generating electricity with a turbine in its tail; when the tail spins like a motor, it blasts its surroundings with lightning. It helps those who seek to build an ideal world, and mythology says it razes the kingdoms of people who have lost the righteousness in their hearts. Ken Sugimori, who gave its name a hard 'Ze' to sound strong, calls it his favourite Pokémon from Black and White.
description.guide: Zekrom is a Dragon- and Electric-type Legendary Pokémon from Unova's legends that helps those who seek an ideal world. It is the counterpart of Reshiram and can fuse with Kyurem to form Black Kyurem.
description.tagline: The black dragon of ideals that hides inside thunderclouds.
